jobs.description:
Title: Head of Operations Engineering

Tenure: Full-Time

Location: Morgantown, WV (Onsite) (Relocation Assistance)

Role Impact:

• The Head of Operations Engineering at our aseptic beverage manufacturing facility plays a pivotal role in ensuring seamless engineering operations across the organisation. This position is crucial for fostering collaboration, driving continuous improvement, and maintaining operational excellence.
• Additionally, the role involves collaborating with Maintenance, EH&S, Process, Controls, and Reliability Engineering to manage plant renovations, improvement projects, and facility expansions, while ensuring efficient operations, supporting production and downtime schedules, and addressing complex challenges to maintain strong system performance

Role Responsibilities

• Oversee the planning, development, and implementation of processes, systems, and resource allocation within the Engineering Department to ensure efficient operations and cost-effective solutions aligned with business needs.
• Monitor, analyze, and report on efficiency KPIs, driving continuous improvements based on insights that align with departmental and organizational objectives.
• Lead initiatives to streamline engineering operations by implementing targeted process and facility improvements, reducing downtime, and boosting overall productivity.
• Oversee the building and management of various budgets such as CapEx (Capital Expenditure), Training, Support/Consulting.
• Responsible for Engineering Drawing controls and processes, and Engineering design and equipment specification
• Oversee CMMS(Upkeep) which serves as the communication link between departments and tracks all engineering and maintenance work, including breakdowns, resolutions, and contractor activities to ensure transparency and historical records of operations.
• Keeping in touch with vendors to make us aware of new industry developments technologies.
• Oversee all new equipment contracts and ensure scope of supply is accurate.
• Allocate tasks and manage resources to optimize workload distribution, ensuring team members are utilized efficiently.
• Collaborate with Production and Technical Integration to integrate existing work into engineering and maintenance schedules.
• Identify gaps in resources and optimize team capacity to meet operational needs, including planning and executing training and cross-training initiatives.
• Work with maintenance to identify and coordinate larger planned shutdowns.
• Support EH&S with procedures, programs, and safety signoffs (LOTO, Start-up and Shutdown)
• Oversee all engineering projects, ensuring accurate scheduling, resource allocation, and department coordination.
• Collaborate with leadership to determine optimal downtime windows and project timing for maximum impact.
• Work closely with Maintenance teams to identify and coordinate larger planned shutdowns.
• Assess the cost-effectiveness of manufacturing processes, making and implementing recommendations to reduce costs and improve efficiency.
• Identify, recommend, and implement new technologies and systems to improve processes and decision-making.
• Establish, communicate, and implement engineering policies, practices, standards, and security measures to ensure effective, safe, and consistent operations.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
• Responsible for adhering to SQF and Food Safety Standards.
• Follow Food Safety Requirement/Standards as needed.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• Oversee the strategic and tactical workflow of the Engineering department.
• Recruit, interview, and develop Engineering team members.
• Delegate work and assign tasks to team members based on expertise, work experience, and time constraints.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering required (Industrial, Chemical, Mechanical, or Electrical).
• MBA preferred.

Experience & Skills

• Manufacturing experience required.
• 10 years or more of related engineering experience required.
• 5-7 years of experience in managing capital projects, budgets, and timelines for engineering and maintenance-related initiatives required.
• Strong knowledge of FDA and PMO design requirements preferred.
• Strong knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices within the food industry preferred.
• Low acid aseptic manufacturing and packaging experience in the beverage market preferred.
• Strong adaptive ability to shift schedules with operational day-to-day needs.
• Proficient with Microsoft project to coordinate and move project/work timelines to meet production needs.
• Ability to read, understand, and create P&ID’s required.
• Extensive knowledge of engineering principles and procedures.
• Excellent ability to methodically troubleshoot problems.
• Excellent analytical and management skills.
• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
• Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent interpersonal skills.
• Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, Microsoft Project, AutoCAD, ERP/CRM systems, and MES systems
• Clear focus on process mapping, particularly for facility or line improvements, including scheduling and planning around production downtimes and operations.
• The role involves driving efficiency by focusing on losses and continuous improvements, requiring a mindset of constant optimization.

Position Overview:

Follett Higher Education is a leading educational service provider and omnichannel retailer, providing students, faculty, staff, parents, and fans with the course materials, learning tools, and retail services needed to successfully support the collegiate journey. Follett Higher Education supports over 6 million students through its 1,100 physical and 1,750 eCommerce campus stores across North America.

This is a high-visibility opportunity to lead a commerce platform transformation on a national scale. The VP of Engineering, Commerce Platform
owns the technical strategy, architecture, and delivery of Follett's ecommerce and point of sale systems, including the ongoing migration from a legacy technology stack to Shopify. This role has final architectural authority over the platform, impacting how millions of students and fans shop and pay for years to come.

The VP brings deep technical credibility, setting direction with conviction, and earning trust across engineering teams. Application Development, QA, and DevOps all report into this role. The VP partners closely with the SVP of Ecommerce, who owns product management and business decisions for ecommerce, while this role owns how those decisions get built, scaled, and operated.

This role owns engineering culture, building a team where engineers own outcomes in partnership with product and leadership, rather than simply executing requirements handed to them.

Responsibilities:

Platform Architecture & Migration

Own end-to-end architecture for ecommerce and POS systems, including the transition from legacy stack to Shopify.
Set technical direction and make final architecture calls across the environment, driving toward the organization's go-forward technology stack.
Act as the subject-matter expert across the modern ecommerce technology stack, including loyalty programs, promotions and pricing engines, and analytics/personalization platforms, to inform architecture decisions that scale across the Follett store network.
Maintain technical standards and architectural integrity across the engineering organization.

Engineering & Delivery Leadership

Lead Application Development, QA, and DevOps teams, setting delivery standards and technical practices across all three functions.
Ensure platform performance, instrumentation, scalability, reliability, and availability to meet the needs of the business and its institutional and student customers.
Drive modern engineering practices appropriate to the team's scale and maturity.
Own technology lifecycle decisions, including system upgrades, platform migrations, and modernization efforts within ecommerce and POS.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with the SVP of Ecommerce on roadmap sequencing, tradeoffs, and prioritization, co-owning outcomes while maintaining clear decision rights between technical execution and business/product ownership.
Work across engineering, sales, institutional partners, and operations to balance platform modernization with ongoing academic-calendar-driven operational needs.
Serve as the technical voice in cross-functional planning for ecommerce and POS initiatives.

Engineering Culture & Talent Leadership

Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing engineering organization across App Dev, QA, and DevOps.
Foster a culture of ownership, where teams partner with product and leadership to own outcomes rather than only executing requirements.
Establish clear performance expectations and growth paths for engineering leaders and their teams.
Raise the bar for technical hiring across the organization.

Secure Development & Risk Awareness

Ensure secure development and deployment practices are embedded in engineering workflows, in partnership with the separate security/compliance function that owns security overall.
Maintain working knowledge of data privacy and security considerations relevant to ecommerce and POS systems (e.g., PII handling, data residency) to inform architecture decisions.

12--15+ years in software engineering, including 5--7+ years in senior engineering leadership (Director, VP, or Head of Engineering) managing multiple teams through leads and managers.
Direct ecommerce software engineering experience, having built or scaled systems for online storefronts, checkout, cart, or order management.

Experience owning DevOps/CI-CD and QA functions as part of an engineering organization, not app development alone.
Demonstrated track record of building engineering teams with a strong culture of ownership.
